## Modine to Host Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Conference Call on November 4, 2026


October 21, 2026


RACINE, Wis.


, Oct. 21, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, announced today that it will host a conference call and webcast to discuss its second quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Central Time (11:00 a.m. Eastern Time). Results are scheduled to be released after the market closes on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.


During the call, Modine President and Chief Executive Officer, Neil D. Brinker, and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Michael B. (Mick) Lucareli, will review the company's second quarter financial results.


To access the live webcast, including presentation slides, please log on through the investor section of Modine's website at[http://www.modine.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802823-1&h=3994484656&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.modine.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.modine.com) at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the event. A replay of the slides and the audio will be available on or after November 4, 2026, on the investor section of Modine's website at[http://www.modine.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802823-1&h=3994484656&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.modine.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.modine.com) . An audio only replay will be available through midnight on November 11, 2026, by dialing 877-660-6853 (international replay 201-612-7415) and entering the Conference ID# 13762536. A transcript of the call will be posted to the company's website on or after November 9, 2026.


**About Modine** For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 9,000 employees worldwide, our businesses advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit[www.modine.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4802823-1&h=2876053246&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.modine.com%2F&a=www.modine.com) .
